propositions: The §I4a headline 'A child never runs ahead of its parent in the lifecycle' overstates the guarantee of the _CASCADING_EDGES enumerated table and must be narrowed to the per-edge, same-edge guarantee it actually provides.

The store enforces the required invariant 'no non-terminal-state ticket can be a child of a closed ticket' jointly through the cascade table's two closed-source rows and the unconditional open-children close guard in transition_close.py, not through a total status ordering.

Reactivating a closed child under an open parent does not cascade because only a closed parent is eligible on that edge; this residual is accepted and documented as consistent with the ruled invariant.

The blocked → in_progress transition must be explicitly documented as non-cascading in the table and §I4a, resolving the disagreement with the start-work gate which fires on that edge, with documented grounds for both behaviors.
